item.description: An automated campaign is using stolen GitHub tokens to plant workflows that print a repository's secrets into its GitHub Actions logs, which the attackers then download before deleting the runs. The attacks have succeeded in private repositories and GitHub Enterprise environments, according...

item.title: iFLYTEK Details SparkAudio 1.0 Speech Foundation Model and Launches Robot Super Brain Platform 3.0
item.description: iFLYTEK's SparkAudio 1.0 pairs a 0.65B audio encoder with a 30B-A3B MoE model trained on domestic chips, while Robot Super Brain Platform 3.0 bundles boards, modules and a harness for robots.

item.title: BOSS Zhipin's Nanbeige Team Open-Sources Nanbeige4.3-33B, a 512K-Context Agentic Coding Model
item.description: The Nanbeige team at BOSS Zhipin parent Kanzhun released Nanbeige4.3-33B on Hugging Face, a teacher model for agentic coding and office work that will be distilled into a 3B version.

item.title: Kingdee Upgrades Lingee Agent Platform, Releases Lingee Bench With 1,400+ Enterprise Agent Tasks
item.description: Kingdee added a manager-facing agent hub, an enterprise context layer and 70 ERP connectors with 1,127 tools to Lingee, and released Lingee Bench to test whether agents finish real business work.

item.title: Xiaomi-Incubated HachimoDock Is a DIY Desktop AI Pet That Sends Voice Tasks to Codex and WorkBuddy
item.description: A team inside Xiaomi's technology committee has published HachimoDock, a desktop AI device that costs about 150 yuan to build, routes voice tasks to PC agents and controls Xiaomi smart home devices.

item.title: Shenzhen Embodied-Chip Startup Primotion Unveils Paimon-0, Cutting Action-Chunk Inference to 300 ms
item.description: Three-month-old Primotion is building robot chips by first training its own model. Paimon-0 tops several embodied AI leaderboards, by the company's account, and cuts action-chunk inference tenfold.
